So, in reading this article during my super secret set-up stage for tackling my weekly quota of grand crosslinking proposals, the sudden appearance of the goat in 886-A reminded me a bit of the effects of SCP-2910, and I began to wonder if perhaps the anomaly there is an imperfect or incomplete version of that which is seen here. As such, I am proposing the following edits:

Changing this:

SCP-886-A-alpha does not know how or why she began to exhibit her anomaly, only that it began suddenly and without warning.

To this:

SCP-886-A-alpha does not know how or why she began to exhibit her anomaly, only that it began suddenly and without warning. Similarities between SCP-886 and SCP-2910 have been noted, and investigation into whether SCP-2910 is a variant or altered version of the anomaly seen within SCP-886 is currently ongoing.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

Cuz I'm bored…MATH!!

So, A-03 was born (at least) ~23 years after A-alpha started birthing goats, and should have a, um, "cousin"(?) the same age. Where are A-01, -02 and -04? -03 was kept for science and they killed her "grandmother", "great-aunt" and "cousin" (at least one of -01 and -02 would've been 15+ at the time, in order to have birthed -03's goat mother)?

That's so much more creepy than the article implies…

+1 for making me chart the family tree.

item.title: I like it... very "retro" feel to it.
item.content:encoded:
There's always a soft spot in my heart for SCPs that make people whine about "why, why, why??" like stupid little kids (no pun intended) and the answer is always "BECAUSE, dude!" I think there's too much of an emphasis on crazy backstories or long-winded explanations. Remember when an anomaly was just an anomaly BECAUSE IT WAS?

Long story short, +1.
